Minimal change nephrotic syndrome (MCNS) (Σ85% of total cases of nephrotic syndrome in children), the glomeruli appear normal or show a minimal increase in mesangial cells and matrix.\nFindings on immunofluorescence microscopy are typically negative

1- Minimal change nephrotic syndrome (MCNS):
- Light microscopy & immunoflorescence ~ normal.
- Electron microscopy ~ lost foot processes of podocytes.
- Usually with selective proteinuria.
- Steroid responsive in > 95%.
immunologically mediated glomerular diseases: Minimal change nephrotic syndrome (MCNS)
